importer_gstin_uk.name: importer_gstin_uk
importer_gstin_uk.where: ((gstin IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))

importer_pan_uk.name: importer_pan_uk
importer_pan_uk.where: ((pan IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))

importer_check.name: importer_check
importer_check.value: ((origin = 'SELF_REGISTERED'::text) AND (created_by IS NULL)) OR ((origin = 'CREATED_BY_ADMIN'::text) AND (created_by IS NOT NULL))

transporter_gstin_uk.name: transporter_gstin_uk
transporter_gstin_uk.where: ((gstin IS NOT NULL) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))

ura_role_importer_idx.name: ura_role_importer_idx
ura_role_importer_idx.where: ((revoked_at IS NULL) AND (importer_id IS NOT NULL))

ura_role_warehouse_idx.name: ura_role_warehouse_idx
ura_role_warehouse_idx.where: ((revoked_at IS NULL) AND (warehouse_id IS NOT NULL))

user_role_assignment_check.name: user_role_assignment_check
user_role_assignment_check.value:
CHECK (
CASE role_domain
    WHEN 'PLATFORM'::wms.role_domain THEN ((warehouse_id IS NULL) AND (importer_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 'WAREHOUSE'::wms.role_domain THEN ((warehouse_id IS NOT NULL) AND (importer_id IS NULL))
    WHEN 'IMPORTER'::wms.role_domain THEN ((importer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (warehouse_id IS NULL))
    ELSE NULL::boolean
END)

user_role_assignment_check1.name: user_role_assignment_check1
user_role_assignment_check1.value: (revoked_at IS NULL) OR (revoke_reason IS NOT NULL)

warehouse_check.name: warehouse_check
warehouse_check.value: (usable_area_sqft IS NULL) OR (total_area_sqft IS NULL) OR (usable_area_sqft <= total_area_sqft)

wms.user_effective_permission.definition: SELECT ura.user_id, rp.permission, max(wms.access_rank(rp.scope)) AS scope_rank, (array_agg(rp.scope ORDER BY (wms.access_rank(rp.scope)) DESC))[1] AS scope, array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT ura.warehouse_id), NULL::bigint) AS warehouse_ids, array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT ura.importer_id), NULL::bigint) AS importer_ids, array_agg(DISTINCT ura.role) AS granted_by_roles FROM wms.user_role_assignment ura JOIN wms.role_permission rp ON rp.role = ura.role JOIN wms.users au ON au.id = ura.user_id WHERE ura.revoked_at IS NULL AND au.deleted_at IS NULL AND au.status = 'ACTIVE'::wms.record_status AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms.permission_override po WHERE po.user_id = ura.user_id AND po.permission = rp.permission AND po.revoked_at IS NULL AND (po.expires_at IS NULL OR po.expires_at > now()))) GROUP BY ura.user_id, rp.permission
wms.user_effective_permission.name: user_effective_permission

wms.v_last_change.definition: SELECT DISTINCT ON (entity_type, entity_id) entity_type, entity_id, entity_label, occurred_at, actor_user_id, actor_name, acting_role, operation, diff, reason FROM wms.audit_log WHERE result = 'SUCCESS'::wms.audit_result AND (operation = ANY (ARRAY['INSERT'::wms.audit_operation, 'UPDATE'::wms.audit_operation, 'DELETE'::wms.audit_operation, 'RESTORE'::wms.audit_operation])) ORDER BY entity_type, entity_id, occurred_at DESC
wms.v_last_change.name: v_last_change
